evidence: log loss +0.0143 (95% interval +0.0025 to +0.0246). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

162 picks, ROI -1.5% (95% interval -14.2% to +10.8%), win rate 58.6% against a break-even 58.8%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 33% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.11 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,920 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,771; a 1% edge takes 44,272. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
